sources.title: PlantCAD2: A DNA foundation model for interpreting genomes across ...
sources.snippet: Here, we introduce PlantCAD2, an extended-context, plant-specific DNA language model with single-nucleotide resolution, pre-trained on 65 angiosperm genomes, together with a series of public benchmarks for evaluation.
